cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.about: A sweeping blow that strikes every foe.
cleave.text: {user} sweeps a blade through all of them!

wall.name: Shield Wall
wall.about: Halves the damage the party takes for two rounds.
wall.text: {user} raises a Shield Wall. Damage is halved for two rounds.

spark.name: Spark
spark.about: Calls lightning and crystals of light down on one foe.
spark.text: {user} calls a Spark down on the {target}!

flit.name: Flit
flit.about: Two quick blows on one foe. Each can be timed.
